title: Native isolation qualification
scenario: Find the synthetic qualification guide and run its bounded CLI on an existing Docker host. Requires Python 3.12+, the verified Codex 0.163.0 arm64 package, pinned image and a Docker-visible staging directory.

steps.title: Open the isolation guide
steps.instruction: In the AK SDLC map, open Self-improvement and eval, select Native isolation / synthetic, then choose Expand all. Follow Sources for the exact prerequisite and CLI commands. Use a fresh private evidence directory. A pass qualifies the synthetic native path only; live transport and promotion remain false. If blocked, inspect receipt.json and correct the stated prerequisite without broadening access.
steps.caption: Actual expanded guide from workflow digest 7d40116c807c, captured on 2026-10-18. This screenshot shows navigation; separate CLI smoke verified execution.
steps.expected: The guide explains the real-client synthetic workflow, denied-access checks, deliberate tool exit 3 and qualification limits.
